About.title: Crafting the Future Through Transparency & Strength
About.description: Since our establishment, PMS GLASS has been dedicated to pioneering architectural glass solutions, tempered safety glass with an unwavering focus on safety, insulation, and aesthetic perfection.
About.missionText: Deliver integrated architectural glass solutions that exceed client expectations in durability, modern elegance, and pinpoint execution accuracy.
About.visionText: To stand as the premier and most trusted reference for high-end glass and aluminum solutions in the region.
About.chairmanTitle: Crafting the Future with Transparent Vision
About.chairmanText: Since the inception of PMS GLASS, our goal has never been merely glass processing, but setting new benchmarks for luxury and safety in modern architecture. We believe every project we execute is a fusion of engineering precision and cutting-edge technology. Our unwavering commitment to quality is what drives us to be the preferred choice for iconic developments.
About.milestoneText: A recognition awarded for the successful execution and delivery of the entire glass facade for the Textile Mall project, utilizing heavy-duty tempered glass engineered for maximum structural safety and aesthetic brilliance.
About.milestoneScope: Project: Textile Mall | Scope: Full Structural Tempered Facades
About.capabilitiesDesc: Leveraging world-class engineering precision and cutting-edge technologies for unmatched structural safety and clarity.
About.ctaDesc: Our engineering consultants are ready to assist with technical specs, drawings, and measurements.
About.cert1Desc: Engineered to withstand up to 5x higher mechanical pressure and thermal shock than ordinary glass.
About.cert2Desc: Double glazing technology combined with Low-E thermal radiation coatings.
About.cert3Desc: 100% rustproof, moisture-resistant hardware crafted for extreme longevity.
About.machineryDesc: Coverage on delivery and installation against all manufacturing and workmanship defects.
